title: Why PJM’s Proposed Backstop Auction Is a Bad Idea

meta.summary:
It’s no secret that data centers are putting enormous strain on our nation’s aging electric grid. But PJM's proposed backstop auction is not a good option, write two members of the NYU Law School's Institute of Policy Integrity. 
 The post  Why PJM’s Proposed Backstop Auction Is a Bad Idea  appeared first on  RTO Insider .
